下部：苍穹无恙第648章自我剥离，神性散尽
第一节权柄归零，斩断万古执道枷锁
九天云台，长风浩荡，贯穿三界万里山河。
置顶于天道公议榜单的金色条目，依旧熠熠生辉，万千众生汇聚的道心意志，澄澈、公允、不含半分私情，道尽了新生苍穹最后的平衡缺憾。天地规则已然圆满，众生自治已然落地，万古乱象已然肃清，唯独第七执笔者凌无妄的存在，是此方无瑕盛世里，唯一的人为漏洞。
凌无妄静立云海之巅，白衣临风，身姿挺拔如初，眼底却彻底褪去了百万年执掌天道的通透神性，只剩凡尘俗世最纯粹的平静与释然。
众生公议，不是逼迫，不是反噬，不是凉薄。
恰恰是他倾尽心血打造的天道公允，最完美的一次落地呈现。
他亲手推翻了神明独裁的万古旧制，亲手搭建了众生评议的公权体系，亲手抹去了天地间所有的特权、偏袒与私念。如今这套极致公正的秩序，剔除所有情感羁绊、功德滤镜、恩情裹挟，以最客观的尺度丈量天地万物，最终得出了唯一的标准答案。
天道无主，方得恒存；执笔者不灭，平衡不存。
从立道之初，他所求的从来不是万古独尊、受万神朝拜、被众生铭记。
他跨越上古道争的废墟，遍历三万年墨规禁锢的黑暗，承受无数次规则反噬与寿元燃烧，打破轮回、重构秩序、解放苍生，毕生奔赴的终极理想，从来都是苍生自主，天道自衡，苍穹无恙。
如今盛世已成，苍生已醒，秩序已稳，他所有的执念、所有的坚守、所有的奔赴，皆已圆满落地。
留存权柄，便是留存私主；留存神性，便是留存偏私；留存自我，便是留存失衡。
既以公道立天地，便需以公道归自身，不搞特殊，不留例外，不存私念。
凌无妄抬眸，望向高悬九天的新生平衡天道，心神澄澈无波，开始了此生最后、也是最彻底的自我剥离。
第一道剥离，斩天道权柄。
盘踞神魂百万年的执笔者权印，无声无息碎裂消融。过往可一念校准规则、一念裁决三界、一念抚平乱象、一念迭代天道的至高权限，尽数归零、彻底作废。
从此，他再无规则修改之权，再无天道兜底之能，再无三界裁决之柄。
他不再是天道的执掌者，不再是秩序的校准者，不再是苍生的庇护者。
他和三界亿万凡人、万千修士一般，沦为新天道规则之下，最普通、最平等的一介生灵。

高空流转的天道道韵轻轻震颤，似在记录这场万古未有之蜕变。百万年来，无数天道执笔者，或贪恋权柄固守神性，或执念秩序沉沦偏执，从未有一人，在功成盛世、万古扬名之际，主动亲手剥离至高权柄，自毁神明尊位。
唯有凌无妄，功成不居，道成身退，自愿褪去所有凌驾众生之上的特权，将一己之身彻底归入苍生，归入天地，归入平凡。
云海翻涌，清风拂面，压在三界头顶百万年的神明枷锁，在这一刻，被彻底彻底砸碎、荡然无存。
第二节神性褪尽，归作凡尘寻常客
权柄剥离之后，便是神性剥离。
凌无妄闭目凝神，催动圆满无瑕的平衡道心，开始逐层剥离根植神魂深处的天道本源神性。
那是自天地初开、天道衍生之初，便专属历代执笔者的本源印记，是凌驾众生生灵之上的至高生命层次，是区分神明与凡俗的终极壁垒。
丝丝缕缕璀璨澄澈的金色神性微光，从他的神魂肌理、血脉筋骨、识海深处缓缓溢散而出，顺着浩荡天风，融入九天天道本源之中。
每一缕神性褪去，他周身萦绕的万古苍茫、大道威压、规则锋芒，便淡去一分。
曾经的他，一眼可勘破万古规则，一念可洞悉天地玄机，一心可推演万种结局。神性赋予他俯瞰众生、贯穿岁月、通晓大道的极致能力，也赋予他居高临下、疏离凡尘、理智极致冷漠的神明桎梏。
神性存，则道心有执，视角有别，众生有隔。
神明看待苍生，是万千数据、秩序棋子、天道组件，纵有悲悯，亦是高位者的施舍与庇护，永远隔着一层无法消融的层级隔阂。
唯有神性散尽，彻底归于凡尘，方能真正与众生平等，方能彻底根除天道偏私的所有源头。
神魂深处，极致的撕扯之感层层蔓延，比任何天罚反噬、规则灼烧都要刺骨难忍。
剥离神性，不是褪去修为，是剥离自身本源的生命层级，是推翻百万年的存在根基，是抹杀与生俱来的神明本源。

Part 2: The Sky is Safe Chapter 648: Self-stripping, divinity dissipated
In the first section, the authority is returned to zero, and the eternal shackles of holding the Tao are cut off.
The Nine Heavens Cloud Terrace is filled with powerful winds that penetrate thousands of miles of mountains and rivers in the three realms.
The golden entry at the top of the public discussion list of heaven is still shining brightly. The Taoist will of thousands of sentient beings gathered together is clear, fair and does not contain any personal feelings. The rules of heaven and earth have been perfected, the autonomy of all living beings has been implemented, and the eternal chaos has been eliminated. Only the existence of the seventh author, Ling Wuwu, is the only man-made loophole in this flawless prosperous era.
Ling Wuwang stood quietly on the top of the sea of ​​clouds, his white clothes facing the wind, his posture as tall and straight as ever, but his eyes had completely lost the transparent divinity that had been in charge of the way of heaven for millions of years, leaving only the purest peace and relief in the mortal world.
Public discussion among all living beings is not coercion, backlash, or indifference.
It is precisely the justice of heaven that he has devoted all his efforts to create, and it is the most perfect implementation.
He personally overthrew the eternal old system of divine dictatorship, personally built a public power system for the evaluation of all living beings, and personally erased all privileges, favoritism and selfish thoughts in the world. Nowadays, this extremely fair order eliminates all emotional fetters, filters of merit, and coercion of kindness, measures everything in the world with the most objective scale, and finally reaches the only standard answer.
The way of heaven has no owner, so it can exist forever; if the person who writes it is immortal, the balance will not exist.
From the beginning of his establishment of Taoism, what he sought was never to be alone in eternity, to be worshiped by all gods, and to be remembered by all living beings.
He transcended the ruins of ancient Taoist disputes, traversed the darkness imprisoned by Mo rules for 30,000 years, endured countless backlashes of rules and longevity burning, broke the cycle of reincarnation, reconstructed order, and liberated the common people. The ultimate ideal he has pursued throughout his life has always been that the common people are independent, the way of heaven is self-balanced, and the sky is intact.
Now that the prosperous age has come to pass, the common people have awakened, and order has been stabilized, all his obsessions, all his perseverance, and all his efforts have been successfully implemented.
To retain authority is to retain selfishness; to retain divinity is to retain partiality; to retain self is to retain imbalance.
Since the heaven and earth are founded on justice, justice must be given to oneself, without being special, making no exceptions, and having no selfish thoughts.
Ling Wuwu raised his eyes and looked at the new balanced heaven hanging in the sky. With a clear mind, he began the last and most thorough self-stripping in this life.
The first step is to peel off the power of Heavenly Dao.
The author's seal of power that had been entrenched in the soul for millions of years shattered and melted silently. In the past, the supreme authority of calibrating the rules, judging the three realms with one thought, smoothing chaos with one thought, and iterating the way of heaven with one thought, will all be reset to zero and completely invalidated.
From now on, he no longer has the power to modify the rules, no longer has the ability to reveal the truth of heaven, and no longer has the authority to judge the three realms.
He is no longer the ruler of heaven, no longer the adjuster of order, and no longer the protector of the common people.
Like hundreds of millions of mortals and thousands of monks in the Three Realms, he has become the most ordinary and equal creature under the new rules of heaven.
The rhythm of the Heavenly Dao flowing high in the sky trembles gently, seeming to record this unprecedented transformation. For millions of years, countless writers of heaven have either been greedy for power and clung to divinity, or obsessed with order and fallen into paranoia. There has never been one person who, on the occasion of great success and eternal fame, took the initiative to strip away the supreme authority and destroy himself as a god.
Only Ling Wuwu, who has achieved success and retreats, voluntarily gives up all his privileges over all living beings, and completely returns his body to the common people, to heaven and earth, and to ordinary people.
The sea of ​​clouds surged, the breeze blew across the face, and the shackles of the gods that had been pressing on the heads of the three realms for millions of years were completely smashed and disappeared at this moment.
Chapter 2: The divinity fades away and becomes an ordinary guest in the mortal world
After authority is stripped away, divinity is stripped away.
Ling Wuwan closed his eyes and concentrated, activated his perfect and flawless balanced Taoist heart, and began to peel off the original divinity of Heavenly Dao rooted deep in his soul layer by layer.
That is the original imprint that has been exclusive to writers of all generations since the beginning of the world and the origin of heaven. It is the highest level of life above all living things., is the ultimate barrier that distinguishes gods from mortals.
Wisps of bright and clear golden divine light slowly overflowed from the texture of his soul, blood vessels and bones, and the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, followed the mighty sky wind, and merged into the origin of the Nine Heavens.
With every ray of divinity fading away, the eternal vastness, the pressure of the avenue, and the edge of rules that lingered around him faded away.
He used to be able to decipher eternal rules with one glance, understand the mysteries of the world with just one thought, and deduce thousands of endings with just one thought. Divinity endows him with the ultimate ability to overlook all living beings, travel through the years, and understand the great road. It also gives him the shackles of the gods to be condescending, alienated from the world, and extremely indifferent to reason.
As long as divinity exists, there will be attachments to the Tao, different perspectives, and separation among living beings.
Gods treat the common people as thousands of data, chess pieces of order, and components of the way of heaven. Even if they are compassionate, they are also the charity and protection of those in high positions. There is always a layer of hierarchical barriers that cannot be dissolved.
Only when the divinity is dissipated and completely returned to the mortal world can we truly be equal to all living beings and can we completely eradicate all sources of partiality in the way of heaven.
Deep in the soul, the ultimate tearing feeling spreads layer by layer, which is more bone-piercing and unbearable than any natural punishment backlash or rule burning.
Stripping away divinity does not mean stripping away one’s cultivation, but stripping away one’s own original life level, overthrowing the millions-year-old foundation of existence, and erasing one’s innate divine origin.
